definitions.explanation: Used when something valuable is wasted or lost, or when a good opportunity is missed.
Used when someone nearly succeeds at something but falls short.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{惜|お}しい。
examples.english: Time is precious. / I don't want to waste time.

examples.japanese: ⟦あんな→あんな：01574_anna⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{惜|お}しい。
examples.english: It's a shame to waste such talent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}く→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{亡|な}くなった→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{惜|お}しい。
examples.english: It's regrettable that they passed away so young.

examples.japanese: {惜|お}しい！⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧だった。
examples.english: So close! You almost had it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{惜|お}しかった⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧だ。
examples.english: The answer was close, but wrong.

examples.japanese: あと⟦{一点|いってん}→一点：08894_itten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{惜|お}しかった。
examples.english: We were just one point away from winning - so close.

notes:
{惜|お}しい is an i-adjective with two related meanings: feeling regret about waste/loss, and being tantalizingly close to success.

SENSE 1 — REGRETTABLE:
Expresses that something valuable is being wasted or lost, or that a loss is lamentable.
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{惜|お}しい: time is precious (don't waste it)
- ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{惜|お}しい: one's life is dear
- ⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{惜|お}しい: it would be a waste to throw away

SENSE 2 — SO CLOSE:
Used when someone nearly succeeds but falls short.
- {惜|お}しい！: So close! (exclamation in sports/games)
- {惜|お}しく⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{負|ま}けた→負ける：01134_makeru⟧: lost by a narrow margin
- あと⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{惜|お}しかった: it was so close, just a little more

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {惜|お}しく⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (regrettably, so close)
- Noun form: {惜|お}しさ (the feeling of regret/closeness)

cross_references.label: to regret, to be reluctant to part with, to begrudge, to spare
